title: Sri Kurmanathaswamy Temple, Srikurmam

buildingCutout.basis: The original outer precinct ring of relation 5943168. Its separate inner ring determines the open court in the model.

terrainReference.basis: Original source height at the south-southwest projecting gate approach.

mapIdentity.provider: Named worship place Q25570463 and OpenStreetMap temple multipolygon 5943168. Both boundary ways and the open courtyard were retained.
mapIdentity.scope: The OpenStreetMap multipolygon provides the precinct perimeter and an open courtyard around the projecting temple. The named worship point and camera coordinates link the photographed shrine, north-facing temple side, courtyard range, and exterior wall to this site.

note: The original Qualla photograph and three exact same-day CC0 originals document the carved stone tiers, weathered stone courses, flat roofed corridors, pillars and brass flagstaff. Government accounts describe the sculptured pillars and eight-petaled sanctum crown. Individual reliefs and the section heights are estimated.
